body:
carries item E7 of #22788; #22788 keeps item E6 (cut beside this one)

Filing gate: **④ a coordination node's execution card**, row E7 of ADR-0139's execution plan. It is cut by #22788's owner (`domain:engine` seat 1, #6367 · `sunhaolin` · `session_01GP3comALHRcRBixS2TEnLF`) now that its predecessor has landed. It lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit` and `packages/services/service-storage`, another lane. Per the split rule it carries no `domain:*`: triage sets the lane and the grade on first touch. ⛔ Classes, positions and functions only.

**Predecessor landed:** E5 (#23673), PR #23693 → `69351e985a`. The activity and ledger gates emit one `ReadableIds` leaf per parent object and do no pre-scan; D5's three classes keep the bounded probe. That is the switch ADR-0139 D4 required to prove the leaf before these three gates take it. Earlier: E1 (#22787), E2 (#22861), E3 + E4 (#23639, PR #23656 → `462dff36f1`).

**Reader who acts:** triage, to set the lane (by the lane table, `plugin-audit` and `service-storage` are `domain:services`) and the grade; then that lane's seat.

## The work (ADR-0139 D4, D5; the plan's row E7)

- **Comment threads and comment reactions** (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts#installCommentReadVisibility`, both branches; bound `#READ_SCAN_LIMIT`), and **attachments** (`packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts#installAttachmentReadVisibility`; bound its own `#READ_SCAN_LIMIT`, 2,000): each takes D4's shape over its own pointer pair. That is one branch `{ <parent object column>: P, <record id column>: { $in: ReadableIds.of(P) } }` per registered parent object, ANDed into the read's `where`, with no pre-scan.
- D5's three classes keep the bounded fail-closed probe, by name: a delegated caller, a parent narrowed by an object-scoped read middleware (note: `sys_attachment`, `sys_comment` and `sys_comment_reaction` are themselves on D5.2's list as gated objects), and a federated parent. The probe is chosen up front, ⛔ never reached by catching a refusal.
- Interim letter C's refusal is retired from these three gates.
- A consumer does not catch the composition refusal into its deny-all sentinel (ADR-0139 D3). The read fails and says why.

## Pins

- **The plan's row:** each gate's own bound case. A reader with more than 2,000 readable candidates sees every visible comment, reaction and attachment; an unreadable parent's rows stay hidden; `count` equals the rows served.
- Each D5 class keeps the probe at each gate.

## Notes carried from E5's report (inputs, noted on #22788 in 6197472558, not filed)

- plugin-security's `explain` answers a SYSTEM context `allowed: false` while `canReadObject` answers true. So a leaf composed in a SYSTEM read selects everything or nothing, depending on which half the service offers. E5 guards its consumer by writing no leaf without `canReadObject`. These gates take the same guard.
- On `driver-mongodb` the switched gates fail 500, which is O3, a ruled consequence (ADR-0139 D3, Consequences).

## Readings this card owes

- **O2 (ADR-0139):** consumers 4 to 6 are source readings, not measured. This card measures each gate's bound case before and after its switch.

## Governing text

ADR-0139 D3, D4 and D5 and the plan's row E7; ADR-0112 (the refusal envelope).
